quotes: read_token: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST open the last component of path once without following a link, resolving the folders above it as they stand, and judge only that opened file: it MUST raise ValueError when the opening fails or meets a link, when the opened file is not a regular file, when its mode gives the group or others any permission, when its content does not decode in the encoding of the imported TOKEN_ENCODING constant, or when what remains after removing the characters of the imported TOKEN_TRIM_CHARACTERS constant at both ends, and no other character, is shorter than the imported TOKEN_MIN_LENGTH constant or holds a character outside the imported TOKEN_ALPHABET constant; otherwise it MUST return that remaining text. No message, log line or exception it raises MAY carry the content of the file. It opens with the flag os.O_NOFOLLOW, whose presence is never tested (A9).

_opened_folder: [PATH_OR_ARTIFACT_POLICY] MUST be a context manager that yields an open descriptor of the folder at the absolute path, reached from the root of the file system one folder at a time, each opened as a folder relative to the one before it without following a symbolic link, and MUST close every descriptor it opened on every exit; a failure to open any of them, a symbolic link or an object that is not a folder among them, MUST raise DelivererError with the FOLDER_UNAVAILABLE member of = models.RefusalCode. It opens with the flags os.O_DIRECTORY and os.O_NOFOLLOW, whose presence is never tested (A9).

_read_source_bytes: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST open entry once, relative to the folder descriptor, for reading only, without blocking and without following a link, and judge the opened object before reading it: one that is not a regular file MUST raise Rejected with the NOT_A_REGULAR_FILE member of = models.PlacementFailure, and a failure to open, inspect or read it MUST raise Rejected with the UNREADABLE_FILE member. It MUST read from the start until the end of the file or one byte past the imported MAX_SOURCE_BYTES constant, whichever comes first, raise Rejected with the TOO_LARGE member when that byte is reached, and otherwise return every byte read together with the status of the opened file taken before reading; the file MUST be closed on every path and never opened again. It opens with the flags os.O_NOFOLLOW and os.O_NONBLOCK, whose presence is never tested (A9).

_atomic_write: [PATH_OR_ARTIFACT_POLICY] MUST make the folder of path exist below base by calling _make_folders with folder_mode as its mode and durable_folder as its durable, creating only the folders of this address and nothing ahead of use, then write content to a fresh temporary file in that folder whose name is the imported TEMPORARY_NAME_PREFIX constant followed by an unpredictable name, created exclusively, without following a link and with the imported TEMPORARY_FILE_MODE constant, a name already taken being passed over for another; the temporary file MUST hold all of content with mode, be durable on storage and closed before it atomically replaces path, so an existing file at path is never absent to a reader. When durable_folder is true the folder of path MUST then be made durable with _sync_folder and any failure fails the write; when it is false that folder is made durable after the replacement and a failure there is neither raised nor undoes the file in place. A failure before the replacement MUST remove the temporary file, leave it when that removal fails too, and raise the original OSError; a temporary file a crash leaves stays and is never read. It opens with the flags os.O_CREAT, os.O_EXCL and os.O_NOFOLLOW, whose presence is never tested (A9).

project_lock: [BEHAVIOR] MUST be a context manager that holds the exclusive lock the operating system keeps per open file of the project's lock file, so another thread of the process waits as another process does, for the whole of the caller's block, waiting for another holder without a time limit and with no retry of its own, and releases and closes it on every exit. The lock file MUST be named by the canonical project id followed by the imported LOCK_FILE_SUFFIX constant in the folder of the imported LOCKS_FOLDER constant below the state_dir of context, which it makes exist with _make_folders, the imported STATE_FOLDER_MODE constant and durable false; it is created exclusively, without following a link, with the imported LOCK_FILE_MODE constant, or, when it exists, opened as it stands without following a link. Neither the lock file nor its folder is made durable, a lock found partly created is completed and nothing created is removed. It opens with the flags os.O_CREAT, os.O_EXCL and os.O_NOFOLLOW, whose presence is never tested (A9).
